title: Managed Trino password resolution goes through facade and falls back to Duckgres password
answers: Which password does the managed Trino connection use?
Trino password fallback to Duckgres password
body:
Managed Trino connections take their password from `get_managed_warehouse_trino_password` (products/managed_warehouse/backend/facade/api.py) -> `common.get_trino_password_for_org` (products/managed_warehouse/backend/common.py). It returns `server.trino_password or server.password`, so unconfigured rows fall back to the Duckgres password. In dev mode it returns the dev DUCKGRES_PASSWORD.
`trino_connection.resolve_managed_warehouse_trino_connection` must call this via the facade, not `get_duckgres_query_server_config`. It raises ManagedWarehouseTrinoConnectionUnavailable on ValueError or an empty password.
Tests should patch `trino_connection.get_managed_warehouse_trino_password`. New facade functions must also be added to `__all__` in facade/api.py.
says: Managed Trino login fails but I don't know which password it tried
Which password gets used for Trino if the Trino password field is empty
Trino connection falls back to Duckgres password when not explicitly set
How is the warehouse password resolved for managed Trino connections
Dev environment Trino uses the development Duckgres password

Calling resolve_managed_warehouse_trino_connection must use the facade function, not get_duckgres_query_server_config directly, and it raises ManagedWarehouseTrinoConnectionUnavailable on ValueError or empty password. Tests should patch trino_connection.get_managed_warehouse_trino_password, and new facade functions must be added to __all__ in facade/api.py.
